w429898168.note: Historic Kronohäktet from 1871: three-storey pale plaster cell block with a hipped roof, regular barred-cell window rhythm, central roof lantern and tall chimneys.

w391945935.note: Sankt Petri kyrka: red brick and sandstone Neo-Gothic Latin-cross church, tall central spire, smaller corner pinnacles and pointed-arch windows.

w1093394319.note: Västervik station, built in 1879: pale yellow three-storey station house with a dark pitched roof, dormers, central gable and regular sash windows.

w312971950.note: Ellen Key school's 1870 main building: three-storey pale yellow plaster with a rusticated granite base, neo-Romanesque arched windows and an arched roofline frieze; low green metal hipped roof.

w391945967.note: Ellen Key school's 1950s wing: three-storey, pale rendered functionalist block with evenly spaced modern windows and a flat roof.

w1361680623.note: Street View, Aug 2024: pale yellow vertical timber cladding, white window and gable trim, steep red tile roof, grey plinth and a small entrance porch.

w1360320789.note: Street View, Aug 2024: two-storey light beige vertical timber siding, white-framed sash windows and a dark pitched roof.

w1357720957.note: V-DATA, Allén 4: the small, light-coloured gabled shop unit beside the taller apartment block, with broad display glazing and red V-DATA lettering on its street-facing gable. Street View, Aug 2024; the adjacent apartment block is a separate building.

w1357781804.note: Corner, Allén 1: low pale restaurant with broad shopfront glazing, a shallow dark metal roof, green awning and a prominent red Corner sign with a smaller Burgers & Grill line. Street View, Aug 2024.

w1036831300.note: Street View, Aug 2024: yellow timber facade, white ornamental trim and arched upper window, dark steep roof; ground floor partly hidden by trees and a black garage door.

w391945954.note: Street View, Aug 2024: pale cream facade, red-painted window frames, arched ground-floor windows and a white corner bay; red tiled roof.

w1354299041.note: Sillgatan 9, Google Street View Aug 2024: low one-storey house with white infill and dark timber framing, broad dark tiled roof with a front dormer, brown entrance door and raised steps.

w1356508678.note: Rådjursstigen 15, Google Street View Aug 2024: one-storey light vertical timber siding, red tiled gable roof, grey stone base and raised entrance steps.

w1037123082.note: Västervik rådhus, Stora torget, built 1793–95: two-storey plastered brick, symmetrical windows and a central raised attic with clock and lantern above a broken mansard roof. Based on Kalmar läns museums public-domain photo and Street View, Aug 2024.
